findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_feedback · Private data: node_status, read_record, list_records, whoami, register_identity, store_memory, store_memory_batch, transfer_records · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: register_identity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_feedback · Private data: node_status, read_record, list_records, whoami, register_identity, store_memory, store_memory_batch, transfer_records · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: register_identity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
